title: Display a sensor reading
prompt: Reading is supplied. Write public static string Display(Reading reading). An offline reading returns "offline", whatever its degrees. An online reading below 0 returns "freezing". Any other online reading returns its degrees in the form "21 degrees". Zero is a real temperature, so it returns "0 degrees".
hints: Which rule ignores the temperature completely? Where must its arm go?
Test Online first, then the freezing range, then fall through to the general text.
Use { Online: false }, then { Degrees: < 0 }, then _ with an interpolated string. Below 0 does not include 0.
checkLabels: An online reading of 0 must return "0 degrees".
An online reading of 21 must return "21 degrees".
An online reading below 0 must return "freezing".
An offline reading below 0 must still return "offline".

wrongAnswers.misconception: Tests the temperature before checking that the sensor is online.

feedback: Find the failing reading and read your arms from the top. Check which rule must win for an offline sensor, and what happens at exactly 0.
